title: Mark Bible Quiz - Chapter 5
description: Ten questions on Mark 5: the man with the legion of unclean spirits, the herd of pigs, the woman who touched his clothes and the daughter of Jairus.

questions.text: Where did the man with the unclean spirit live?
questions.explanation: Mark 5:3 says that he lived in the tombs, and nobody could bind him any more, not even with chains.

answers.text: In a boat by the shore
In the city of the Gadarenes
On the roof of a house

questions.text: What name did the spirit give when Jesus asked, "What is your name?"
questions.explanation: He said to him, "My name is Legion, for we are many."

questions.text: What happened to the herd of pigs after the unclean spirits entered them?
questions.explanation: The herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea, and they were drowned in the sea.

answers.text: They were driven into the city
They were kept by those who fed them
They rushed into the sea and drowned

questions.text: How did the people find the man who had been possessed by demons?
questions.explanation: They came and saw him sitting, clothed, and in his right mind, and they were afraid.

answers.text: Still crying out among the tombs
Sitting, clothed and in his right mind

questions.text: Where did the man begin to proclaim what Jesus had done for him?
questions.explanation: He went his way and began to proclaim in Decapolis how Jesus had done great things for him, and everyone marveled.
Jairus was one of the rulers of the synagogue, who came and fell at Jesus' feet.

answers.text: One of the rulers of the synagogue
One of those who fed the pigs

questions.text: How long had the woman in the crowd had a discharge of blood?
questions.explanation: Mark 5:25 says she was a woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years.

questions.text: What did the woman say before she touched his clothes?
questions.explanation: She said, "If I just touch his clothes, I will be made well," and she touched his clothes in the crowd.

answers.text: That he would lay his hands on her
That she must first tell him the truth
That the physicians could still help her
That touching his clothes would make her well

questions.text: What did Jesus say about the child when he came to the synagogue ruler's house?
questions.explanation: When he had entered in, he asked why they made an uproar and wept, and said the child is not dead, but is asleep.

answers.text: That she is not dead, but asleep
That she would rise on the third day
That her father's faith had failed
That no one should come inside

questions.text: What did Jesus say when he took the child by the hand?
questions.explanation: Taking the child by the hand he said to her, "Talitha cumi!" which means, "Girl, I tell you, get up!"
